column1: # ih_clauses.tsv — induction-hypothesis clause table for gen_ih_clause.py
# One line per clause; each emits Vsa/Sim/rows/IHClause_<name>.lean
# (namespace Vsa.Sim.IHClause.<name>). Columns (tab-separated):
# Columns are matched by the header row's names; `kind` may be omitted (= extra).
#   name    : clause name (Lean identifier, CamelCase); module and namespace suffix
#   kind    : extra  — pred : EvalExtra (N A SL φf φc sret.toNat c), embedded into the
#                      motive through `EvalIHWith.toM` (generated `extraM`, `ofWith`)
#             extraM — pred : EvalExtraM (N A SL φf φc sp sret m0 c), e.g. a footprint
#                      `footExtra F` (Vsa/Sim/ExitFootprint.lean); the motive is
#                      `EvalIHWithM extraM` (= `EvalIHF F` for footprints)
#   pred    : the Lean term of the kind's type: the fact retained at the child's
#             actual return
#   imports : comma-separated modules the pred/dischargers need ('-' for none);
#             Vsa.Sim.TermCaseBundle, Vsa.Sim.ExitFootprint and Vsa.Sim.IHClauseSupport
#             are always imported
#   motives : clause motives of the OTHER eight relations, `Rel=<Lean term over the
#             relation's binders>` separated by ';' ('-' = all `True`); relations:
#             EvalArgs Call ExecS ExecInit ForLoop ForCond ExecStep ExecSeq
#   guard   : '-' or a Lean Prop over the `mEvalE` binders (`st d env e st' v`), e.g.
#             `Vsa.Sim.IHClauseGeneric.noAllocExpr e = true`; the EvalE motive becomes
#             `<guard> → EvalIHWithM extraM …`, so every clause child IH and the clause
#             parent of a step carry it (a step outside the guard is vacuous)
#   steps   : per-case discharge tags `<case>=<tag>` separated by ';', `*` = default
#             for every case not named; a case is a TermCases premise (hInt, hBinary, …)
#             whose PARENT relation has a non-True clause motive. Tags:
#               manual                — the field stays a residual (default)
#               generic:<id>          — the field stays; its doc comment names the
#                                       generic discharger <id> (agent L2) and the hook
#               from_old:<Lean term>  — wired: <term> maps the case's old-motive
#                                       conclusion (hOld) to the clause conclusion
#                                       (`EvalIHWithM extraM …`; use `ofWith` to lift
#                                       an `EvalIHWith extra` result)
#               exact:<Lean term>     — wired: <term> has exactly the field's type
#               unguarded:<term>|<proj_1>|…|<proj_k>
#                                     — wired (guarded clauses): <term> has the field's type
#                                       WITHOUT the guard on the EvalE child IHs and the
#                                       parent; proj_i : <guard parent> → <guard child_i>
#                                       for the i-th EvalE child (none for a leaf), e.g.
#                                       `unguarded:footprint.hNeg|noAllocExpr_unary`
#               unguarded:<Lean term> — wired (guarded clauses, cases without child
#                                       derivations): <term> has the field's type without
#                                       the guard; the generator discards the guard
#   notes   : free text
